candidate_workaround: Locate exact generated-file anchors first, then apply small single-purpose patches.
failure_signature: A broad multi-context patch was rejected because a generated-file anchor did not match exactly; no file changed.
recurrence_guard: Use fixed-string line discovery and one exact patch hunk per generated-file concern.
rollback: Retain the rejected patch at zero credit and verify no file changed before retrying.
scope_boundary: Same-owner additive patch recovery only; no scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Exact generated-file anchor recovery after rejected patch
trigger_preconditions: A patch must change long generated text and adjacent validation constants.
